data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Bah’ (Brahma) and ‘Rul’ (flag or banner), Baharul is believed to represent the divine presence of Lord Brahma. This name evokes a sense of divinity and spiritual connection. The name Baharul carries the meaning “Brahma's banner” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Baharul usually hope their child will grow to embody brahma's banner and live with faith, good character and purpose.
